imageAnalysis.label: Noise Analysis
imageAnalysis.tip: Detect and remove noise in the image
imageAnalysis.explain: This tool analyzes the image to detect noise and visual artifacts, and provides options for correcting them.

noiseDetectionButton.tip: Analyze the image and highlight areas containing noise or compression artifacts.

noNoiseDetected.title: No significant noise detected
noNoiseDetected.message: No noticeable noise or artifacts were detected in the image.

removeNoiseButton.tip: Remove detected noise to improve image clarity.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.tip: Adjust detection sensitivity. Higher values detect more noise, while lower values detect only stronger noise.

backgroundRemoval.label: Background Removal
backgroundRemoval.tip: Remove the background from the image

color.label: Color
color.tip: Remove a specific color from the image
color.explain: Select a reference color in the image and adjust the sensitivity. Lower values remove only exact matches, while higher values also remove similar shades.

manual.label: Manual
manual.tip: Remove areas manually by drawing over the image
manual.explain: Manually mark areas to remove by drawing over the image. The tool size determines how large the removed area will be.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.tip: Automatically detect and remove similar areas
auto.explain: Automatically detect regions with similar pixels in the image and select them for background removal.

replaceSelection.label: Replace selection
replaceSelection.tip: Replace the current selection with a new one or add to the existing selection

backgroundColor.label: Color to remove
backgroundColor.tip: Pick the reference color to remove from the image

removalSensitivity.label: Sensitivity
removalSensitivity.tip: Adjust how similar a pixel must be to the selected color to be removed. Low values remove only exact matches, high values also remove similar shades.

selectColorButton.tip: Pick the reference color directly from the image

highlightColor.label: Highlight color
highlightColor.tip: Select the color used to highlight the selected area

edgeSoftness.label: Soft edge radius
edgeSoftness.tip: Adjust the softness of the selection edge to create smoother transitions between removed and remaining areas.

boundaryOffset.label: Boundary shift
boundaryOffset.tip: Expand or shrink the selection boundary. Positive values expand the removed area, negative values shrink it.

selectRemovedButton.tip: Select the removed area of the image

useBaseImage.label: Use base image
useBaseImage.tip: Apply removal to the original image instead of the currently modified image

replaceBackgroundColor.label: Replace selection with color
replaceBackgroundColor.tip: Fill the selected area with a color instead of making it transparent

backgroundReplacementColor.label: Replacement color
backgroundReplacementColor.tip: Choose the color used to replace the removed area

highlightColor.label: Highlight color
highlightColor.tip: Select the color used to highlight the selected area

autoRemovalSensitivity.tip: Adjust how similar pixels must be to the selected pixel to be included in the automatic selection.

highlightColor.label: Highlight color
highlightColor.tip: Select the color used to highlight the selected area

select.label: Select
select.tip: Select and manage objects on the image
select.explain: Select one or multiple objects placed on the image. Click an object to select it, hold Shift to add more objects to the selection, or drag a rectangle to select multiple objects at once. Selected objects can be moved or deleted.

transform.label: Transform
transform.tip: Rotate, flip, or resize the image

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.explain: Rotate the image in 90° steps using the left and right rotation buttons.

flip.label: Flip
flip.tip: Flip the image horizontally or vertically
flip.explain: Flip the image horizontally or vertically.

resize.label: Resize
resize.explain: Resize the image by adjusting its width and height. The aspect ratio can be locked to maintain proportions or reset to the original dimensions.

crop.label: Crop
crop.tip: Crop the image manually or use Fit Crop
crop.explain: Crop the image by defining a rectangular crop area. Move the crop box with the mouse or enter exact position and size values. The aspect ratio can be locked while resizing.
crop.explain2: Fit Crop automatically detects and removes background-like areas from the edges of the image. Sensitivity controls how aggressively the background is detected.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.tip: Adjust how aggressively background-like pixels are included in the crop detection

useBaseImage.title: Use base image
useBaseImage.tip: Use the original image for crop detection instead of the current crop area

hideCropBoxButton.tip: Show or hide the crop box to view the full image (or press and hold Spacebar)

invalidCropBox.title: Invalid crop
invalidCropBox.message: Crop dimensions or position are invalid. The crop area must stay within the image and have a positive width and height.

cropBoxIsSameAsOriginalImage.title: Crop unchanged
cropBoxIsSameAsOriginalImage.message: The crop area matches the original image. No crop was applied.

sameCropBoxAfterFit.title: Crop area unchanged
sameCropBoxAfterFit.message: Fit Crop did not change the crop area. Try increasing sensitivity or ensure the background is uniform.

grayscale.label: Grayscale
grayscale.explain: The Grayscale tool converts the image to shades of gray, removing all color information. This is useful for creating monochrome versions of images or focusing only on light and shadow without color distraction.

grayscaleType.label: Grayscale type
grayscaleType.tip: Select the method used to convert the image to grayscale

options.luminanceExplained: Weighted average based on human perception
options.averageExplained: Simple average of the RGB values
options.lightnessExplained: Average of the max and min RGB values

brush.label: Brush
brush.explain: Paint directly on the image using a brush. Adjust the tool size and color to create different strokes and highlights.

brush.label: Brush
brush.explain: Paint on the image using a soft brush. Adjust the brush size and color to control the appearance of the strokes.

pencil.label: Pencil
pencil.tip: Draw precise lines on the image
pencil.explain: Draw on the image using a pencil. The pencil creates sharper and more defined strokes compared to the brush.

toolSize.label: Brush size
toolSize.tip: Adjust the size of the brush

rasterizeButton.tip: Rasterize the image before using the brush tool

toolSize.label: Pencil size
toolSize.tip: Adjust the size of the pencil

rasterizeButton.tip: Rasterize the image before using the pencil tool

clearAllButton.tip: Remove all painted strokes from the image

blur.label: Blur area
blur.tip: Adds blur area to the image
blur.explain: The Blur area tool applies a blur effect to a selected rectangular area of the image. The size, position, and rotation of the blur box can be adjusted manually or by entering exact values. The blur strength slider controls how strong the effect is.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.tip: Adjust the rotation angle or double click icon to reset rotation

blurStrength.label: Blur strength
blurStrength.tip: Adjust the strength of the blur effect

edgeFade.label: Edge fade
edgeFade.tip: Adjust the fade of the blur effect towards the edges

shape.label: Shape
shape.explain: The Shape tool allows adding vector shapes to the image. Shapes can be positioned, resized, rotated, and styled with fill, stroke, opacity, and line options. Shapes can also be reordered using Z-index controls.

rectangle.label: Rectangle
rectangle.tip: Add a rectangle shape to the image

ellipse.label: Ellipse
ellipse.tip: Add an ellipse shape to the image

line.label: Line
line.tip: Add a line shape to the image

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.tip: Adjust the rotation angle or double click icon to reset rotation

enableFillColor.label: Enable fill color
enableFillColor.tip: Enable or disable fill color for the shape

fillColor.label: Fill color
fillColor.tip: Select the fill color for the shape

strokeColor.label: Stroke color
strokeColor.tip: Select the stroke color for the shape

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.tip: Adjust the opacity of the shape or double click icon to reset opacity

cornerRadius.label: Corner radius
cornerRadius.tip: Adjust the corner radius of the shape or double click icon to reset corner radius

lineType.label: Line type
lineType.tip: Select the type of line for the shape

start.label: Start arrow
start.tip: Enable or disable start arrow for the line

end.label: Line end
end.tip: Enable or disable end arrow for the line

magnifyArea.label: Magnify Area
magnifyArea.tip: Magnifies a specific area of the image
magnifyArea.explain: The Magnify Area tool highlights a chosen part of the image by enlarging it. The zoom level, radius, position, outline, and Z-index can be customized to control how the magnified section is displayed.

type.label: Type of magnify area
type.tip: Select the type of magnify area

radius.label: Radius
radius.tip: Adjust the radius of the magnified area

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.tip: Adjust the zoom level of the magnified area

resultPosition.label: Result position
resultPosition.tip: Select the position of the magnified area result

outlineWidth.label: Outline width
outlineWidth.tip: Adjust the width of the outline around the magnified area

outlineColor.label: Outline color
outlineColor.tip: Select the color of the outline around the magnified area

text.label: Text
text.explain: The Text tool allows adding text to the image. The font, size, color, opacity, style, rotation, and position can be customized. Text can also be layered with other elements using Z-index controls.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.tip: Adjust the rotation angle or double click icon to reset rotation

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.tip: Adjust the size of the text

fontFamily.label: Text font
fontFamily.tip: Select the font for the text

textColor.label: Text color
textColor.tip: Select the color of the text

textOpacity.label: Text opacity
textOpacity.tip: Adjust the opacity of the text or double click icon to reset opacity

frame.label: Frame
frame.tip: Adds various types of frames such as solid, browser or phone
frame.explain: The Frame tool adds a visual frame around the image. Different frame types such as solid, browser, or phone frames are available. Frame color, width, outlines or headers can be customized.

frameColor.label: Frame color
frameColor.tip: Select the color of the frame

frameWidth.label: Frame width
frameWidth.tip: Adjust the width of the frame or double click icon to reset width

usePhoneButtons.label: Phone buttons
usePhoneButtons.phoneButtonsCanNotBeDrawnTip: Phone buttons can not be drawn, because the image is not height enough

phoneOutlineSize.label: Outline size
phoneOutlineSize.tip: Select phone outline size from 3 options

phoneHeaderIconsSize.label: Icons size
phoneHeaderIconsSize.tip: Select phone header icons size from 3 options

phoneBatteryIconStyle.label: Battery icon style
phoneBatteryIconStyle.tip: Select phone header battery icon style

headerSize.label: Header size
headerSize.tip: Adjust the size of the header or double click icon to reset size

footerSize.label: Footer size
footerSize.tip: Adjust the size of the footer or double click icon to reset size

phoneButtonsCanNotBeDrawn.title: Phone buttons can not be drawn
phoneButtonsCanNotBeDrawn.message: Phone buttons can not be drawn, because the frame is not height enough.

preset.label: Presets
preset.tip: Applies a preset to the image
preset.explain: The Create Preset tool saves a set of image operations as a preset. Supported operations include rotate, flip, crop, resize, grayscale, frame. Current modifications can be saved as preset or operations can be manually selected.
preset.explain2: The Apply Preset tool applies a saved preset to the image. Presets can be modified, new operations can be added, and the order or values of existing operations can be adjusted before applying.

useCurrentModifications.tip: Use current image modifications as preset values

phoneOutlineSize.label: Outline size
phoneOutlineSize.tip: Select phone outline size from 3 options

phoneHeaderIconsSize.label: Icons size
phoneHeaderIconsSize.tip: Select phone header icons size from 3 options

phoneBatteryIconStyle.label: Battery icon style
phoneBatteryIconStyle.tip: Select phone header battery icon style

presetAlreadyExists.title: Preset already exists
presetAlreadyExists.message: A preset with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.

invalidPresetName.title: Invalid preset name
invalidPresetName.message: Preset name cannot be empty or contain special characters.

presetContainsCropOperation.title: Preset contains manual crop operation
presetContainsCropOperation.message: Preset will not be applied automatically if image will be smaller than crop box.

presetContainsMultipleCropOperations.title: Preset contains multiple crop operations
presetContainsMultipleCropOperations.message: Preset can not be created with multiple crop operations. Please use maximum one crop operation.

phoneOutlineSize.label: Outline size
phoneOutlineSize.tip: Select phone outline size from 3 options

phoneHeaderIconsSize.label: Icons size
phoneHeaderIconsSize.tip: Select phone header icons size from 3 options

phoneBatteryIconStyle.label: Battery icon style
phoneBatteryIconStyle.tip: Select phone header battery icon style

crop.label: Crop
crop.tip: Invalid crop box for this image

deletePresetConfirmation.title: Delete preset
deletePresetConfirmation.message: Are you sure you want to delete the preset: {presetName}?

presetSuccessfullyDeleted.title: Preset deleted
presetSuccessfullyDeleted.message: Preset with name: {presetName} has been successfully deleted.

presetSuccessfullySaved.title: Preset saved
presetSuccessfullySaved.message: Preset with name: {presetName} has been successfully saved.

successfullyApplied.title: Preset applied
successfullyApplied.message: Preset with name: {presetName} has been successfully applied.

presetAlreadyApplied.title: Preset already applied
presetAlreadyApplied.message: Preset with name: {presetName} is already applied to the image.

closeWithoutSavingConfirmation.title: Close without saving
closeWithoutSavingConfirmation.message: Are you sure you want to close without saving changes?

presetContainsMultipleCropOperations.title: Preset contains multiple crop operations
presetContainsMultipleCropOperations.message: Preset can not be created with multiple crop operations. Please use maximum one crop operation.

addPresetOperationsOrReplace.title: Add preset operations or replace
addPresetOperationsOrReplace.message: Do you want to add preset operations to the current image operations or replace them?

export.label: Export
export.tip: Exports the image and allows setting the output format

fileQuality.label: File quality
fileQuality.tip: Adjust the quality of the exported file

copyToClipboardButton.tip: Copy the image to the clipboard without exporting (PNG format)

exportButton.tip: Export the image in the selected format

confirmNeedRasterization.title: Rasterization Required
confirmNeedRasterization.message: This operation requires rasterization because image contain vector objects. Rasterization will convert vector objects to pixels, which may result in loss of quality.

confirmNeedBaseImageRasterization.title: Base Image Rasterization Required
confirmNeedBaseImageRasterization.message: This operation requires rasterization of the base image because it contains vector objects. Rasterization will convert vector objects to pixels, which may result in loss of quality.

confirmNeedOverlayMerge.title: Merge Raster Layer
confirmNeedOverlayMerge.message: This operation will merge the raster layer with the main image. All content, including brush strokes and other rasterized objects, will become part of the image and cannot be edited separately afterwards.

infoOverlayWasMerged.title: Canvas overlay merge
infoOverlayWasMerged.message: Canvas overlay was merged with the main image to proceed with this operation.

tip.title: Change viewport background mode
tip.text: Change the background mode of the viewport to normal, contrast light or contrast dark for better visibility of the image edges.

tip.title: Pixelation mode
tip.text: Switch between automatic, always-on, or disabled pixelation to control how the image is displayed when zooming.

tipDisabled.text: Pixelation mode is not available for vector images

tip.title: Noise in image
tip.text: The image contains many subtle pixels that may appear to be part of the background but are actually noise or visual artifacts. These artifacts can result from compression or image processing. Click this message to hide or show highlight of these pixels.

artifactsWarning.message: High noise level in the image

colorEyeDropper.tipUnsupported: Eye dropper is not supported in your browser
